summary.name: RealVNC
summary.one_liner: RealVNC is a remote access and remote support software suite, built by the creators of VNC technology, with separate viewer and server apps.
use_cases: Accessing and managing devices from anywhere
Offering remote IT support to teams
Standardising remote support tooling after a Windows 11 migration
Secure remote access to critical systems
Remote access across mixed desktop and mobile devices
summary.what_it_does: The page describes RealVNC as remote access software that works across major desktop and mobile operating systems. It offers an all-in-one app for everyday device access and general IT support, and separate VNC Viewer and Server apps for operators and engineers who need more control. Security features named are full session encryption, granular permission controls, and authentication options. Connections are said to auto-adjust to network speed, and the software can be configured and customised to business needs.
notable: Separate VNC Viewer and VNC Server apps
Full session encryption with granular permission controls
Built by the creators of VNC technology
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing claims and testimonials; ratings and awards are self-reported on the page
